Leah: hey team 👋 got my Fedora laptop and trying to bootstrap with asdf. ruby and python builds fail with 'ld: cannot find -lcrypto'. also Okta SSO gives a blank page when I try to clone dotfiles. who to ping?
Diego: welcome! first try installing dev headers: `sudo dnf install -y openssl-devel zlib-devel xz-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel gcc make pkgconfig`
Diego: then export PKG paths before asdf: `export OPENSSL_DIR=/usr; export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/lib64/pkgconfig` ; for ruby use `RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl-dir=$OPENSSL_DIR" asdf install ruby 3.1.2`
Riley: for Okta, open the repo URL in the browser where you're signed into Okta. if you see a blank page, clear Okta cookies or sign in again in a new tab; IT sometimes blocks embedded auth flows.
Leah: did the dnf install and exports, ruby and python built after that. Okta fixed by signing into Okta in Chrome, then cloning worked. thanks!
it-support-bot: device registered: leah-fedora (asset HN-4012). file a ticket if unexpected.
Leah: all good now — dotfiles pulled and direnv enabled. will add my SSH key via the web UI. thanks folks :pray:
